overloads.semanticRole: The Get subrecord key command facilitates the migration of 4D code using converted subtables to standard code for working with tables.Beginning with version 11 of 4D, subtables are not supported.

constraints: idField must be a field of the special 'Subtable Relation' type (or a converted 'Longint' field) created when 4D migrated a pre-v11 subtable into an automatic relation between two standard tables; intended only to support migrating that legacy code to standard relation-based code, not for new automatic relations.
